note: Internal. What each wrapped tool can do, taken from its pinned release's documentation, set against the tool-use registry (migkit/tooluse.py). A capability names the registry options it covers as 'command option' (command empty for a program without subcommands); its state is computed, never written. 'candidate' marks a capability that would deepen the rung named in 'rung' and is worth a backlog row while it is unused. 'unaccounted' holds the libraries and programs called with no tool-use account: capabilities from the pinned release and no options, so no state; each gets an account option by option once one exists.

system_programs.docker: container runtime the sandbox and images run on
